name: v6.0.0
body:
### Breaking Changes

- **docker:** Stop publishing Docker images ([#183](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/183)) ([8b87ea3](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/8b87ea349ea5c3e9ff856566f52faf0d28184e5e))
- **cli:** Replace -b/--bootstrap-servers with repeatable -b/--bootstrap-server ([#203](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/203)) ([ef675ed](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/ef675edad04416699fec3ee45bfe6cc5257d68b2))
- **config:** Move timeouts to settings.yaml and scope --timeout per command ([#204](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/204)) ([395f6fe](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/395f6fe0c9d92137b6db2aac2f4f50f285ce4446))
- **consumer:** Default keys and values to string ([#226](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/226)) ([5a6e2cd](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/5a6e2cd6122a6c549395de7867df3d25e47c9e27))
- **python:** Drop Python 3.10 ([#239](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/239)) ([763d03e](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/763d03e61fb361624c5ed337e0cafb62781840fb))

### Dependencies

- **deps:** Upgrade confluent-kafka to 2.16 and remove the Authlib warning workaround ([#191](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/191)) ([fe3955b](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/fe3955b256fe0656f7ff734328e657c27c2317d9))
- **deps:** Bump the github-actions group with 3 updates ([#221](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/221)) ([7d76108](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/7d761088a3ce5c6ac0a6095e29ad65dd4078f288))
- **deps:** Bump pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish ([#227](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/227)) ([f1a023b](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/f1a023bb546606ab153b79d1a8adf350a7150f68))
- **deps:** Bump astral-sh/setup-uv ([#247](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/247)) ([c854e04](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/c854e04cea74ae85b2f32c8ae25f147a67d7281e))
- **deps:** Bump astral-sh/setup-uv ([#253](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/253)) ([05a3d75](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/05a3d758ee096df35d30a6ab3b3037ca58a2322a))
- **deps:** Bump amannn/action-semantic-pull-request ([#255](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/255)) ([090daa1](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/090daa1a6a000809f6448c591dbb67ca32afbc6a))
- **python:** Support Python 3.15 ([#256](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/256)) ([894d3ca](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/894d3ca6fcc262776e93d27d79b98737fbd408aa))

### Features

- **ui:** Show the Kantrip profile in the main header ([#182](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/182)) ([f84bdff](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/f84bdff93c7b7cb920eafd250e761fa5623d1667))
- **consumer:** Show header details in boxes ([#217](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/217)) ([a8650cd](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/a8650cd0dfc098020f6efa4dc1d77fa776ce12d2))
- **producer:** Add interactive record producer ([#207](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/207)) ([d0cf7b1](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/d0cf7b1ee766fd78f872fdcdb83f41474e03d25e))
- **producer:** Highlight JSON in the Key and Value editors ([#219](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/219)) ([fddc5ec](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/fddc5ec72df3383e0140424caa2443eaff2b19eb))
- **producer:** Serialize Avro, Protobuf, and JSON Schema with Confluent and Apicurio registries ([#222](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/222)) ([d62af5e](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/d62af5ec3e98a9279b10a76fccd77f42cd96bc2a))
- **producer:** Register schemas when auto-registration is enabled ([#223](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/223)) ([5d25ddc](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/5d25ddc38a4b65bb2bb0ff8171c11e851a416fbe))
- **protobuf:** Add include folders for source imports ([#248](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/248)) ([2237675](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/2237675058c18ec1c5099f6f2dd8d9c93a92dbca))
- **producer:** Turn --idempotence into a flag ([#250](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/250)) ([b662dc6](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/b662dc6b1aacb1c85c63602fd6d90952643954a5))
- **admin:** Add a read-only mode ([#249](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/249)) ([e576331](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/e57633105cbd187e8834d108a5c3b246e23a5187))
- **admin:** Review topic changes before applying them ([#251](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/251)) ([fe86cbf](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/fe86cbf7bb9b372e2dbcd3d18e95446871ea8cde))
- **admin:** Reset consumer group offsets and delete groups ([#252](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/252)) ([acf3cfc](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/acf3cfc3f59e07fa44ad04a6d38f9c311014d2c5))

### Fixes

- **site:** Loosen hero heading letter spacing ([#189](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/189)) ([ea334c4](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/ea334c430aec54af68cc2dfa20f9189723c640f7))
- **consumer:** Close the Confluent Schema Registry client on exit ([#192](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/192)) ([897aeff](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/897aefffb3c0a17652b71082832ffac637f52d1f))
- **admin:** Open edit and describe without flashing the table ([#209](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/209)) ([7112a6a](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/7112a6aecee5abac02d5e183967d3acbae972b65))
- **admin:** Shade the Advanced topic settings like record content ([#210](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/210)) ([3f50d54](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/3f50d544c83e2897e1fd0a4e83dddfd1ad7ac63c))
- **admin:** Start the cleanup policy cursor on the configured policy ([#211](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/211)) ([b781139](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/b78113939e7263621f25f767dd6b0c5046248d58))
- **tables:** Stretch columns before the first frame ([#215](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/215)) ([f67ff46](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/f67ff46a36b00a71232b5ebe6988fce353fd6cd9))
- **consumer:** Copy only the content from Key and Value ([#220](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/220)) ([2bf89e2](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/2bf89e2f1658726366b931996664d2177b65db84))
- **tui:** Resolve header version at construction ([#229](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/229)) ([af2ab00](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/af2ab007e94e920d07066ff422498283b4bb1e39))
- **tui:** Keep table focus after slow loads ([#234](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/234)) ([c1e683f](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/c1e683fe1e4ee295a41165d4885ecc2395837a1d))
- **site:** Scale the demo padding with the text ([#246](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/246)) ([cb19545](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/cb1954548cd7c600ac00feae3230283891cf1e26))

### Documentation

- **usage:** Suggest a symlink for the short ksk command ([#185](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/185)) ([fe93f22](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/fe93f226c0d85b14f4520364a60e9c5a8cb58189))
- **usage:** Suggest kas as the short command name ([#186](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/186)) ([c60eb1b](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/c60eb1be6923ed2bfcb03195aae19f79f323b453))
- Update the guides and website, and use one slogan ([#187](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/187)) ([1bf98e4](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/1bf98e41a0dd41c2b3b08924d0c51206276aeae9))
- **usage:** Link the agent skill and the cheatsheet ([#190](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/190)) ([665be6e](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/665be6e2c314e73a412e5cda70e5c9b2b9c01591))
- Add MIGRATION.md for v4 to v5 and v5 to v6 ([#206](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/pull/206)) ([16477e5](https://github.com/sauljabin/kaskade/commit/16477e5a64a0c32821bca4d733426fb28a9162d1))
